final: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, SUM(Bytes) as total_bytes, SUM(Milliseconds) as total_milliseconds, CASE WHEN SUM(Milliseconds) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) ELSE NULL END as bytes_per_ms_rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms_rate) as avg_rate FROM album_stats WHERE bytes_per_ms_rate IS NOT NULL), with_diff AS (SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.bytes_per_ms_rate, a.bytes_per_ms_rate - o.avg_rate as difference FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE a.bytes_per_ms_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, bytes_per_ms_rate, difference FROM with_diff ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
